text: Aquatic Cloak (Japanese: , Suijō Meisai, Aquatic Camouflage) is a Gem in that reduces the detection range of aquatic enemies by a percentage. __TOC__
The Archaeology Level (Japanese: , Iseki Kenkyū-ban) is a location in . It is located on the fifth floor of Frontier Village.

Ancient Rhogulias (Japanese: , Taikochō Rogoria) are two quest exclusive enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Rhogul family and can be found by the Ether Planter on the Splintered Path only during the quest Defend Colony 6 - Ancient. After restoring 75% of Colony 6 the quest will trigger and two of these will appear.

Amorous Arca (Japanese: , Enshō no Āruka) is a Unique Monster in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a Mechon, and can be found at level 57 near the third floor Bulkhead Controls in Mechonis Field. Nearby enemies may join the battle, two M66/TRICKs and two Defensive/ONIONs.

Arachno Pods (Japanese: , Supaido Poddo) are normal enemies in . They are Pods that can be found at level 10 in Tephra Cave, between Tephra Cavern and Vilia Lake. They are also fought as Story Exclusive Enemies at level 7 alongside the Arachno Queen in the Arachno Queen's Nest. These variants drop no Treasure Chests, do not respawn, and detect by sight at a 360° angle, to a distance of 20 meters.

Archer Tirkins are enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family, and can be found from level 13 - 15 in Gaur Plain on the Bionis' Leg. They can drop the Tirkin Tail Feathers needed for Material Quest 2.

Anchor Chain (Japanese: , Ankā Chein) is one of Reyn's arts in . It activates an aura that grants immunity to Knockback and Blow-Down, raises non-volatile Aggro to all enemies by 200 per second, and prevents aggro loss when taking damage while the aura is active. In , Nene can use this art.

Arena Orlugas are enemies in . They are members of the Orluga family, and can be found at level 34 in Makna Forest, at the bottom of the Abyss Basin. Defeating three of them is required to complete the Frontier Village's quest Monster Quest 2 - Part 3. In addition, they can drop the Fancy Orluga Masks needed for Material Quest 2.

Ammos Orlugas are enemies in . They are members of the Orluga family, and can be found at level 34 in Makna Forest, southeast of the Glowmoss Trihenge. Defeating two of them is required to complete the Frontier Village's quest Monster Quest 2 - Part 2. Additionally, they can drop the Fancy Orluga Masks needed for Material Quest 2.

Arachno Silk is a rare material in . It can be traded for with various NPCs, or dropped by Arachnos and Pods in Tephra Cave and the Bionis' Leg. According to their description, they are silk threads from cocoons that retain heat and feel warm. Three pieces are needed for Arachno Silk Fundraising.

Ancient Documents are Key Items in Xenoblade Chronicles. There are three of them, and collecting all three is required to complete Mystery of Makna Ruins 1. The Ancient Documents can be found in the following locations, all in Makna Forest: * At the western end of Bridge Two. * At river level on a small piece of land north of the eastern side of Bridge Two. * In a dead-end northwest of the Pod Landing Site and east of Valak Pass.

An Errand for the Heropon (Japanese: , Yūsha no Otsukai) is a Story Quest in . It is received in Frontier Village after Riki is introduced by Chief Dunga. The party must collect Riki's armour from the Frontier Village Armour Shop and his weapons from the Weapon Shop. Riki joins the party upon the completion of this quest. ※ After this quest is completed, several quests may become available: * Zukazu may offer A Big Brother's Fight. * Modamo may offer Lousy Lizards. * Pepa may offer Decoration Makeover. * Pipiki may offer Strange Noises from Below.

The Aortic Pathway (Japanese: , Daidōmyaku no Kairō) is a location in . It is located near the center of the lower level of the Bionis' Interior, and is the only path from the lower level to the upper. It is inhabited only by two Jelly Selua and a Wool Selua.

Andos Alloy Plates are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can only be dropped by Andos in the High Entia Tomb, or traded for with Lesunia in Alcamoth. According to their description, they are resilient nickel alloy plates and a house built with them would surely be fire-proof.

Ancient Armours are rare materials in . They can be traded for with Rosemary and Suzanna in Colony 9, and are not dropped by any enemies. According to their description, they are a product of ancient technology that is too complex for current Homs science.

Andos Fire Armours are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can only be dropped by the Reckless Galdon in Tephra Cave. Andos Fire Armours are otherwise unavailable. According to their description, they are armour that is resistant to any flame and they make fantastic frying pans.

Arachno Ears are rare materials in . They can be dropped by several types of Arachno in Tephra Cave and can be traded for in Colony 9 and at the Refugee Camp. According to their description, they are ears used for collecting sounds and they could be turned into sensors.

Antol Pheromones are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be traded for with Anna, Daza, and Dulland or dropped by Antols in Colony 6. According to their description, they are an ingredient in love potions and adding too much will attract ants.

Anti-Mechon Weapons are weapons in which, as the name suggests, can harm Mechon. In the early stages of the game, Mechon can only be harmed by the Monado or weapons that have been enchanted using Monado Enchant; however, Dickson begins to manufacture weapons made of Mechon parts, which can cut through their armour. The first one seen is wielded by Dunban when he and Dickson help the party fight Metal Face at Colony 6 (after the party exits the Ether Mine). Other Anti-Mechon Weapons made by Dickson can be bought at Sword Valley. They can be dropped by Mechon from any point after this, and are also sold in the Machina village on the Fallen Arm. Weapons starting with "Anti-Mechon" are made by D
is an Aquatic Enemy]] Aquatic Enemies are enemies in that swim in the water. [U] = Unique Monster

Ancient Wreckage (Japanese: , Tsuirakushita Kodai no Fune, The Crashed Ancient Vessel) is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located at the Cylinder Hangar in Colony 9, between Melia and Reyn at purple affinity.

Ancient Astrology (Japanese: , Inishie no Senseijutsu) is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located on the outer road around the first floor of Alcamoth - west of Melfica Road - between Melia and Sharla at purple affinity.

The Arendt Bridge (Japanese: , Ārento Burijji) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Primordia, in the northern central part of the region, northeast of FN Site 111. This land bridge leads to Castaway Cavern.

An Obstacle in Our Path (行く手を阻む者, One Who Gets in Our Way) is a Field Track in , composed and arranged by ACE+. It is track 11 of the third disc from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack. This track is heard during the great majority of Boss and Story Exclusive Enemy battles throughout the game, meaning scripted encounters or almost any battle where the party is trapped by a green barrier and must defeat the monster(s) within to make the barrier disappear. While this theme is associated with the cutscenes prior to most scripted battles, and even a few after, there is notably one instance where it plays during a cutscene not directly associated with a battle, namely the reawakening of the Mechon

Ancient Mysteries (神秘, Mystery) is an Event Track in , composed and arranged by Manami Kiyota. It is track 11 of disc 1 from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack, and track seven of disc three from the Xenoblade Definitive Edition Original Soundtrack and the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This music is an enigmatic theme that is heard in the following cutscenes: * When the party arrives at Mag Mell Ruins for the first time * The party discusses the Telethia and High Entia with Dickson before setting out for Satorl Marsh. * Melia speaks to a recreation of her ancestor in the Ceremony Hall during her trial in the High Entia Tomb. * Emperor Sorean discusses the awakening of the Bionis

Apprehension (予感, Presentiment) is an Event Track in , composed and arranged by Manami Kiyota. It is track 19 of disc 1 from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack. This music is an enigmatic, ominous theme that is heard in the following cutscenes: * Dickson discovers the Monado expedition team dead and young Shulk inside Ose Tower (14 years ago) * Shulk's vision of Otharon dying in the Central Pit * The creation of Face Nemesis

Apricas (Japanese: , Dometomu) are towering deer- or moose-like enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Primordia, Noctilum, and Oblivia, as well as a mission-exclusive one in Cauldros. They are similar to Cervuses.
Amphibious Enemies are enemies in that can live both on land and in water. [B] = Boss [U] = Unique Monster [Q] = Quest Exclusive Enemy [S] = Story Exclusive Enemy

Amrita Scirpos (Japanese: , Amurita Shirunea) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Scirpo family and can be found at level 11-12 or at level 17-20 at Rustpool Banks in Noctilum. Defeating five of them is required during the mission Squashing Scirpos.

Angry Simius (Japanese: , Angā Shimiusu, Anger Simius) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Simius and can be found at level 27 in the Canopied Nightwood and level 29 in the Whale's Gullet and Serpentine Pass in Noctilum.

Ancient Progen (Japanese: , Enshento Ekuusu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Progen and can be found at level 31-38 in Oblivia, east of FN Site 309. Four must be defeated during Arms Testers Wanted.

Antares Levitaths (Japanese: , Antaresu Rukiora) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Levitath family, and can be found at level 55-60 at Rustpool Banks and the Divine Roost in Noctilum during the night.
Arch Caro (Japanese: , Āku Nokkusu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Caro family and can be found at level 41-50 in Cauldros's Wildcat Fortress.

Ancient Coronids (Japanese: , Enshento Regurī) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Coronid family. They can be found at level 51-70 roaming Lake Ciel in Sylvalum. The normal-sized Ancient Coronids range from level 59-64, while the largest Ancient Coronid ranges from level 51-68. During a crimson aurora, they are replaced with Frenzied Coronids, and the largest is replaced with Ignit, the Ultimate Chaos.
Ancient Warscape (Japanese: , Kosen no Tenbōdai) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Cauldros, north of the Cauldros Gate and overlooking Scholes Battlegrounds.
Ancient Warscape BC (Japanese: , Kosen no Tenbōdai BC) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a BLADE base camp run by the Interceptors, located in the Ancient Warscape in Cauldros.

Arenatects (Japanese: , Rorongu) are huge tortoise-like insectoids in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They could be considered the counterparts of Tectinsulas, as their general appearance, materials, and habits are similar. All of them have ether-attribute counter spikes that activate upon gaining the Enraged aura. They can be found in Sylvalum and Cauldros.

The Anvil Sandplain (Japanese: , Anbiru-gan no Sunahara) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Sylvalum, northeast of Samuel Incline and beneath Anvil Rock One and Anvil Rock Two. Luxaar's Xern floats high above Anvil Sandplain, surrounded by various high-leveled Ganglion crafts.

Ancient Allures (Japanese: , Inishie no Yūwaku) are unique collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Primordia. It is possible to find them on the beach around Biahno River by FN Site 103 and nearby the Plundered Ruin. Six of them are needed for the mission An Ancient Mystery.
Aprica Assault is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Prospectors and the primary destination is Primordia.

The Ant's Nest (Japanese: , Anto Nesuto) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a cave located in Oblivia, just southwest of the Aaroy Plain on the edge of the Yawning Giant chasm. It has three entrances and is not connected to either the North Ant's Nest or South Ant's Nest.

Anhydrous Radiators (Japanese: , Shinshiki Musui Rajiētā) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found far northwest of Primordia in Stickstone Rise and around FN Site 103. Two each are needed for A Hero's Ride and A Proper Chopper.

Angelita, the Blade Bouquet (Japanese: , Kenrin no Anherita) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Sacrifole family. It can be found hidden at level 61 in the M'gando Mineral Spring in Cauldros. Defeating it is required to complete the eponymous Basic Mission Angelita, the Blade Bouquet.
Amidresian Tomatoes (Japanese: , Amidoreshia Tomato) are prime collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Primordia, near Sayram Lake. One is needed for The Bug Whisperer.
Angel Stones (Japanese: , Enjerusutōn) are unique collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Oblivia. Eight are required for An Angelic Accessory.
Antorus Roses (Japanese: , Antorousu Rōzu) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Sylvalum. Four of them are needed for Hair Apparent.

Appetizing Suid Tails are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained primarily from the posterior appendage of Suids. They are used for rank I - V Ranged Attack Up, Ranged Attack Boost, Ranged Accuracy Boost, SpecUp.R-ATK, Boost.R-ACC, and Boost.R-ATK augments, and all Ranged Accuracy Up, Ranged Accuracy Drive, Ranged Attack Drive, and SpecUp.R-ACC augments.
Arc Sand Ores are common Precious Resources in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are a component of many Rank I augments. Twenty pieces are needed for The Platinum Membership.

Arc Rock (Japanese: , Āku Rokku) is a Scenic Viewpoint in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located on the flat top of one of Sylvalum's large arch structures, northwest of and above FN Site 410. As with all Scenic Viewpoints, its discovery yields an achievement ("The Discovery of Arc Rock").
Anvil Rock One (Japanese: , Daiichi no Anbiru-gan) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Sylvalum, above the Anvil Sandplain. It is occupied by the Ganglion.

Anvil Rock Two (Japanese: , Daini no Anbiru-gan) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a large rock structure located in Sylvalum, connecting eastward to Anvil Rock One, northwest to the West Cinderdunes, and west to the FN Site 407 and the Lesser Anvil. It is also directly above Anvil Sandplain.

Andrea, the Famished Hunter (Japanese: , Garō no Andorea) is a Tyrant in . It is a member of the Caecus family. It can be found at level 51 near FN Site 402 in Sylvalum, wandering back and forth across the west edge of Lake Ciel, accompanied by a pack of Villainous Caecuses. Defeating it is required for the Basic Mission Off the Record (biological) in the .

Antara, the Water Diviner (Japanese: , Konsui no Antara) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Arenatect family. It can be found at level 46 hidden at West Cinderdunes in Sylvalum.

Anselm, the Triumphant (Japanese: , Kōzentaru Anserumu) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Sylooth family. It can be found at level 58 at Delusians South Summit in Sylvalum. Defeating it is required to complete the eponymous Basic Mission Anselm, the Triumphant.

Aquatic Visigels (Japanese: , Wōtā Narukī) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Visigel family, and can be found at level 66-68 in the Noctilucent Sphere Interior in Sylvalum.

Aprica Back Moss are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from the backs of Apricas. Two are needed for the Normal Mission From Idea to Inventory. They are also used to craft rank I - V Incapacitation Surge augments.

And Stay Out! is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from the Drongo Caravan in Cauldros. This mission requires to gather three Odorous Tentacle from Bluff Gerrids but can also be obtained from Land Gerrids.
Appendage Erosion is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Mastermind at rank 5. It increases the damage done to appendages for every debuff on an enemy.
Animal Lover is a Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located south of Ishmael Hills in the Residential District of New Los Angeles between Phog and Cross at any time.
Ancient Armors are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Xe-doms.
An Ancient Mystery is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from a historian and the primary destination is Primordia.

An Ancient Legend (Japanese: , Inishie no Denshō) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Nimu Turton on the Starboard side of the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles. Note: A dialog choice made during Slovity's Rampage determines whether it is possible to get her help and achieve Route B in this mission.
Ant Misbehavin is Phog's third Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It occurs in the afternoon in the construction zone southwest of the Residential District's Deliverance Park.

Anomaly Analysis is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from Julius and the primary destination is the Commercial District. Although not required to accept it, this mission leads into the Normal Mission Going Viral.
An Angelic Accessory is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from a female BLADE member and the primary destination is Oblivia.
Animal Shelter is a Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located anytime at West Melville Street in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles between Mia and Cross.
Amethyst Metals are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from the back and body appendages of Badul's Seidr. They are components for rank XV - XX Aura Surge augments.
Arenatect Shells are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Arenatects. They are used to craft rank X - XX Soft Touch augments.
Aprica A is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a green aprica variant. It can be obtained from Oskar, the Summer Squall in Noctilum.
Aprica B is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a red aprica variant. It can be obtained from Sviatoslav, the Reproachful in Oblivia.
Arenatect A is a Holofigure in . It depicts a pale yellow and red arenatect variant. It can be obtained from Man'an, the Water Whisperer in Sylvalum.
Arenatect B is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a lavender purple and green arenatect variant. It can be obtained from Antara, the Water Diviner in Sylvalum.

An Omnivore's Use is a Squad Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is part of BLADE Mission No.4, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting twelve Xiphias. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.
Antispike is a ground armor special Augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X that gives a chance to avoid spike damage. The Skell equivalent is Spike.EVA.

Appendage Crusher is a ground weapon special Augment in and that "softens" enemy appendages by one tier per equipped augment, thereby increasing the amount of damage dealt. Hardness tiers start at base 0 (100% damage dealt), and can range from +5 (10%) to -5 (250%). Any additional augments past what is required to reduce the appendage hardness to -5 have no effect. Appendage Crusher augments do not affect damage when targeting the main body.
is a Skell frame antidamage augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It increases damage by 10% to 50% for each Skell appendage lost.
is a Skell frame antidamage augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It increases evasion by 2% to 40% for each Skell appendage lost.
Antipulsers are shoulder weapons for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Colubrims or Oc-servs.
The Archetype Sword is a craftable Longsword in Xenoblade Chronicles X. This weapon can be crafted at the AM Terminal.
The Archetype Slair II is a craftable Longsword in Xenoblade Chronicles X. This weapon can be crafted at the AM Terminal.
The Archetype Sword II is a craftable Longsword in Xenoblade Chronicles X. This weapon can be crafted at the AM Terminal.

The Archetype Launchers are craftable Psycho Launchers in Xenoblade Chronicles X. This weapon can be crafted at the AM Terminal.
Archetype Blades are craftable melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Dual Swords and can be crafted at the AM Terminal.
Archetype Ralzes are craftable melee weapons in . They are Dual Swords and can be crafted at the AM Terminal.
Archetype Blades II are craftable melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Dual Swords and can be crafted at the AM Terminal.
Archetype Knives III are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Knives and can be crafted at the AM Terminal.
Archetype Rivs are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Knives and can be crafted at the AM Terminal.
Archetype Knives II are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Knives and can be crafted at the AM Terminal.
|-|Normal = |-|Advanced = Archetype Paives are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Shields and can be crafted at the AM Terminal.
The Archetype Shield is a melee weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Shield and can be crafted at the AM Terminal.
The Archetype Spear is a melee weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Javelin and can be crafted at the AM Terminal.
The Archetype Spear II is a melee weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Javelin and can be crafted at the AM Terminal.
The Archetype Parce is a melee weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Javelin and can be crafted at the AM Terminal.
Archetype Sabers are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Photon Sabers and can be crafted at the AM Terminal.
Archetype Fulge is a melee weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Photon Saber and can be crafted at the AM Terminal.
Archetype Fulge II is a melee weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Photon Saber and can be crafted at the AM Terminal.
Archetype Avagar is a ranged weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is an Assault Rifle and can be crafted at the AM Terminal.
Archetype Assault Rifle III is a ranged weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is an Assault Rifle and can be crafted at the AM Terminal.
Archetype Assault Rifle II is a ranged weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is an Assault Rifle and can be crafted at the AM Terminal.
Archetype Dual Guns are ranged weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Dual Guns and can be crafted at the AM Terminal.
Archetype Gemels are ranged weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Dual Guns and can be crafted at the AM Terminal.
Archetype Dual Guns II are ranged weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Dual Guns and can be crafted at the AM Terminal.
Archetype Lastyr II is a ranged weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Raygun and can be crafted at the AM Terminal.
The Archetype Raygun is a ranged weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Raygun and can be crafted at the AM Terminal.
Archetype Lastyr III is a ranged weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Raygun and can be crafted at the AM Terminal.
The Archetype Machine is a ranged weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Gatling Gun and can be crafted at the AM Terminal.
Archetype Repethe is a ranged weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Gatling Gun and can be crafted at the AM Terminal.
Archetype Machine II is a ranged weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Gatling Gun and can be crafted at the AM Terminal.
The Archetype Sniper Rifle is a ranged weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Sniper Rifle and can be crafted at the AM Terminal.
Archetype Sniper Rifle II is a ranged weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Sniper Rifle and can be crafted at the AM Terminal.
The Archetype Retic is a ranged weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Sniper Rifle and can be crafted at the AM Terminal.

Anna (Japanese: ) is a Homs in . She can first be found at the Refugee Camp on Bionis' Leg. After everyone in the Refugee Camp has been moved back to Colony 6, she can be found in front of the Reconstruction HQ, or near Colony 6's Main Entrance.
The Architect (Japanese: , Sōsei no kami, lit. "God of creation") is a character in . He is designed by Masatsugu Saito, the lead character designer of the game.

The Argentum Trade Guild (Japanese: , Avaritia shōkai, lit. Avaritia Company) is a Nation in . It is a mercantile organization located amidst the Argentum Titans, carried by the largest Titan in the area, Goldmouth. The Guild itself is built upon on a ship attached to this Titan, who serves to navigate the Cloud Sea like a balloon. The Argentum Trade Guild is a consortium of crafty merchants that has become enriched through it skillfully taking advantage of tensions between nations and exploiting the trade of war. It is one of the eleven Nopon Merchant Guilds found across Alrest, and the only accessible one. According to the quest Nopon Doubloons Ahoy, six other guilds are named in the game:
The Ancient Ship (Japanese: , Kodai-sen) is a story-exclusive area in . It is located in an uncharted region of Alrest. It is impossible to return to the Ancient Ship after Chapter 1.
The Argentum Bazaar (Japanese: , Avaritia Bazāru) is a location in . It is located in Goldmouth at the Argentum Trade Guild, between the Central Exchange and the Salvage Deck.

The Ancient Ship, Deck (Japanese: , Kodaisen Kanpan) is a landmark in . It is the first location visited on the Ancient Ship, and leads directly to the Entrance. There are no enemies here except the initial story-exclusive boss. Following Pyra's reawakening, this landmark is replaced by the Point of Awakening.

Amumu is an NPC in . Amumu is a Nopon who can be found at the Argentum Bazaar in the Argentum Trade Guild. Amumu runs a shop called Nopox Hobby Store specialized in Board Games. Amumu offers no quests or merc missions.

The Ardainians are human-like people who originated on the Titan Mor Ardain in . Of all the races in Alrest, they bear the most resemblance to Homs and Humans, having no noticeable differences in appearance. They make up the majority of the population on said titan, and can also be found living in Argentum Trade Guild, Gormott Province, and elsewhere.
Ardainian Bear Carvings are Art Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Yafush Antiques in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain. They are one of the favorite Pouch items of Nia.

Antecedent Xiaxia (Japanese: , Reigō, Model Zero) is a Unique Monster in . It is an Artificial Blade, and can be found at level 99 in the Artificial Blade Adjustment of the Old Factory in the Empire of Mor Ardain after entering the First Low Orbit Station.

Anangham #2 Dock (Japanese: , Anan'yamu Dai-ni Funatsukiba) is a landmark in . It is located on the Lower Level of the Empire of Mor Ardain, and is the first landmark visited in Mor Ardain. It is part of Port Anangham itself.
Anastatia's (Japanese: , Yadoya Anasutāshisu) is a Landmark in . It is an inn located in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal.
Amphoret Pillar (Japanese: , Amureto Shichū) is a location in . It is located on the Upper Level of the Kingdom of Tantal, between the Theosoir Rear Gate and Twin Pillars.

The Ansel Hatchery (Japanese: , Anseru no Hanshokuchi) is a location in . It is located in the Fonsett Waters of the Leftherian Archipelago. There is a Salvage Point found here. The Shimmering Feather must be retrieved here during Hero of the Nopon.

The Ardainian Garrison (Japanese: , Superubia Chūtonchi) is a landmark in . It is located on the Central Plain of Temperantia, south of Desta Plains. A pack of Garlus move across the plain south of the Garrison. A shop, Dokkdokk Trading, is run here after A Ripe New Frontier. Nim's Heart-to-Heart, "Nim-Speak", can be viewed here.

The Ancient People's Driftland (Japanese: , Kyūbunmei no Hyōryūchi) is a Landmark in . It is located on the Streets of the Land of Morytha. It is where Rex and Mythra end up after falling from the Gotrock Oracle Ruins.

The Architect's Room (Japanese: , Kami no Heya) is a landmark in . It is located on the Lower Level of the First Low Orbit Station, between the Old Temple and the Storage Area Entrance. It is where the Architect resides, with the Conduit just beyond the outer walls. There are no enemies here.

The Argan Iceblooms (Japanese: , Hyōka Āgen Kyūryōchi) are a location in . They are located in the far east of the Lower Level of the Kingdom of Tantal, beyond the Lumos Pedestal. The Flowers of Ice can be found here during Cannadea's Troubles.

Argentum Noodle Soups are Staple Food Pouch items in . They can be purchased between 00:00 and 04:59 at Noodler's Delight in Goldmouth in the Argentum Trade Guild. It can also be purchased for 240 G from the Pouch Item Emporium in the Land of Challenge after collecting the Nopon Invitation, Pt. 2 on Version 1.5.2 or later.
Ardainian Arms Album are Literature items in . They can be purchased at the Haskefell Books run by Phanail in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain.
The Aquaneze Deeds are Store Deed key items in . They can be purchased from Aquaneze Cosmetics in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya.
Ancient King's Portraits are Art Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Memoria Art in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal.
Aquaneze Cosmetics is a shop in . It is run by Ruvie and can be found in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya. It is specialized in Cosmetics.

They are found primarily in the Titan Battleship and Torigoth Relay Base in Gormott Province in and on or near the Ardainian Flagship moored to Lascham Cove in Gormott in . After Mòrag joins the party in Chapter 4, most of these soldiers become nonhostile, turning into generic unnamed NPCs, while the members of the Ardainian insurgent groups Brionac or Lindwurm will still attack the party. Ardun Rearing is an informal quest in . It does not appear in the quest log. It is initiated by speaking to Pekka at Kloom Farm in Torigoth, Gormott. He asks for assistance in feeding the farm's newborn Ardun, after which he can be spoken to again anytime and given various collectibles as food for the Ardun. When enough food has been given, the Ardun advances to its next stage of growth, eventually becoming Relentless Arduran, a level 99 Unique Monster. The Ardun can be fought anytime, but if killed before it reaches the final stage, it will be permanently dead and will not respawn.
